<function name="GravGunPickupAllowed" parent="ENTITY" type="hook">
	<description>Called by <page>GM:GravGunPickupAllowed</page> on ALL entites in Sandbox-derived  gamemodes and acts as an override.</description>
	<realm>Server</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="ply" type="Player">The player aiming at us</arg>
	</args>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="boolean">Return true to allow the entity to be picked up</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
